uutiset.t: Alcaraz defeats Shelton to reach championship match at ATP Finals
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz made it a lucky 13 wins in a row against Ben Shelton to reach Sunday's showpiece of the ATP Finals in Turin.

uutiset.t: Liverpool frustrate Chelsea as Keating heroics leave WSL title race wide open
uutiset.s: Liverpool frustrated Women's Super League leaders Chelsea with a stubborn defensive display to earn a goalless draw at the BrewDog Stadium leaving Manchester City with the opportunity to move top of the table.
Lossiemouth made every yard of the running as she coasted to victory to make it back-to-back wins in the William Hill Morgiana Hurdle at Punchestown.

uutiset.t: Norwich hit back to beat Cardiff
uutiset.s: Norwich came from behind to beat Cardiff 2-1 and make it five straight Championship victories - after losing their previous five.

uutiset.t: Southampton see off Derby to return to winning ways
uutiset.s: Cyle Larin returned to action with a bang as Southampton extended their unbeaten run at home in the Championship to 18 games with a 2-0 victory over second-bottom Derby.

uutiset.t: QPR battle to victory at 10-man Millwall
uutiset.s: Nicolas Madsen's scruffy winner gave Queens Park Rangers their first away victory since August as they defeated Millwall 1-0 at The Den.

uutiset.t: Soccer Saturday panel baffled by decision to disallow Haaland goal!
uutiset.s: The Soccer Saturday panel were baffled by the speed of the decision by the on-field officials and VAR to disallow Erling Haaland's goal after he was adjudged to have fouled Bernd Leno.
